The path ${C}_{1}$ consists of a line segment from the point $A(-2,2)$ to the point $B(-1,2),$ and the path ${C}_{2}$ consists of a line segment from the point $B(-1,2)$ to the point $D(-1,0).$

Given that ${\int }_{{C}_{1}}F\cdot \text{d}r=-\frac{7}{2},$ evaluate ${\int }_{C}F\cdot \text{d}r,$ where $F(x,y)=(x-y)\,i+(y-x)\,j,$ and $C={C}_{1}\cup {C}_{2}.$
